## Placeholder context

This is a scrutiny:pending stub epic capturing planning-workflow insights surfaced during the 2026-05-24 re-brainstorm of the Jira sync remediation epic (superseded epic 3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f). Expand via /dso:brainstorm <epic-id> when the team has bandwidth to design the enhancements.

## Problem

The brainstorm/preplanning pipeline (Agent Clarity, Scope, Value, Feasibility, Red Team, Blue Team reviewers + scrutiny gate + cross-epic scan) does not reliably surface architectural defects that live in the *integration* between modules — only those visible in single-module code or single-document review. The Jira sync remediation epic (3a03) shipped a snapshot-diff design that all reviewers passed; pass-1 live verification surfaced a P0 inversion bug in the differ→applier contract that none of the review layers could see. Same shape recurred across multiple brainstorm rounds for the same functionality. Each prior implementation bug (ProjectKey null → priority dict → add_label flag → architectural inversion → bridge_state persistence) hid the next; reviewers saw code in isolation while the integration was never exercised end-to-end until live pass 1.

## Candidate enhancements (for future brainstorm)

1. Mandatory live-spike before scrutiny for class:architectural epics. A throwaway script that exercises the core pipeline against real external state with no writes. The empirical first-line check catches bug classes the reviewer pipeline structurally cannot.

2. Bug-class-to-property-test mapping requirement at spec-write time. Every prior in-class bug must correspond to a property assertion in the new design; unmapped bug classes signal a design hole. Enforce as a gate.

3. Targeted pre-mortem dispatch beyond Red Team's adversarial scenarios. A focused 'find the next architectural bug class that reviewers won't catch' dispatch using the prior failure pattern as priming context.

4. Capability probe layering correctness. The existing capability_check convention is too easy to write at the wrong layer (verifying surface features that aren't the load-bearing contract). Require probe layer to be specified explicitly: surface / contract / integration / topology.

5. Integration-test-first gate for replacement epics. When a new epic supersedes a closed-with-defect epic, require the new spec to include a property test that would have caught the prior defect. Forcing function: the new design must demonstrably differ from the prior design at the level the prior failure occurred.

## Source incidents

- Prior epic: 3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f (closed superseded by the new Jira-sync remediation epic)
- Architectural defect: bug 7f36-6ca9-d9ae-432b (closed superseded)
- Process bugs already on file: 0dee-a535-45dd-4bc4 (brainstorm/preplanning research depth at insufficient depth); fe3a-a3fb-4523-4ccc (impl agent ignored old code)

## Not in scope

Specific implementation of any enhancement — those are designed during the future expansion brainstorm.
data.title: Brainstorm/preplanning workflow enhancements: empirical validation before scrutiny
